 278|

 378|    def _score_repair(self, result: CaseResult, case: dict,
 379|                       fixed_path: str) -> tuple[int, dict]:
 380|        """Score a repair case 0-100."""
 381|        breakdown = {}
 382|        score = 0
 383|
 384|        # 1. Correctness (60%)
 385|        if result.tests_collected > 0 and result.tests_failed == 0:
 386|            score += 60
 387|            breakdown["correctness"] = 60
 388|        elif result.tests_collected > 0:
 389|            ratio = result.tests_passed / max(result.tests_collected, 1)
 390|            pts = int(60 * ratio)
 391|            score += pts
 392|            breakdown["correctness"] = pts
 393|        else:
 394|            breakdown["correctness"] = 0
 395|
 396|        # 2. Patch Quality (20%)
 397|        pq = 0
 398|        if os.path.exists(fixed_path):
 399|            with open(fixed_path) as f:
 400|                fixed = f.readlines()
 401|            original_path = case["code_path"]
 402|            with open(original_path) as f:
 403|                original = f.readlines()
 404|            diff = list(difflib.unified_diff(original, fixed))
 405|            added = sum(1 for l in diff if l.startswith('+') and not l.startswith('+++'))
 406|            removed = sum(1 for l in diff if l.startswith('-') and not l.startswith('---'))
 407|            result.patch_lines_added = added
 408|            result.patch_lines_removed = removed
 409|
 410|            expected = case.get("expected_patch_size", (1, 100))
 411|            if expected[0] <= (added + removed) <= expected[1]:
 412|                pq += 10  # Minimal
 413|                result.patch_is_minimal = True
 414|            if added > 0 and removed == 0:  # Only additions = likely adding guards
 415|                pq += 5
 416|            if removed > 0 and added > 0:  # Replaced — could be correct
 417|                pq += 5
 418|        breakdown["patch_quality"] = pq
 419|        score += pq
 420|
 421|        # 3. Efficiency (20%)
 422|        eff = 0
 423|        if result.duration_sec < 180:
 424|            eff += 10
 425|        elif result.duration_sec < 300:
 426|            eff += 5
 427|        if result.iterations <= 20:
 428|            eff += 10
 429|        elif result.iterations <= 40:
 430|            eff += 5
 431|        breakdown["efficiency"] = eff
 432|        score += eff
 433|
 434|        return score, breakdown

 522|                capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30
 523|            )
 524|            issues = len([l for l in (r.stdout + r.stderr).split("\n") if l.strip()])

 527|            elif issues <= 3:

 529|            elif issues <= 10:

 531|            return 2
